text.위 에이전트가 판단해 위임 도구로 아래 에이전트를 부른다. 아래 에이전트: The upper agent decides when to call the lower agent with the delegation tool. The lower agent runs separately with its own session, backend, model and resources, and its result comes back as the tool result. The lower agent can also delegate again or ask the user.
text.다른 에이전트에게 일을 맡기는 위임 도구의 이름·안내 문구입니다. 비우면: Name and guidance text of the delegation tool that hands work to other agents. Leave empty to use the default text.
text.에이전트가 일을 맡길 때 부르는 도구 이름입니다(영문·숫자·_·-, 64: Name of the tool the agent calls to hand off work (letters, digits, _ and -, up to 64 characters).
Change this when it clashes with another tool name or the agent has trouble recognizing it.
text.에이전트에게 보이는 도구 설명입니다. {targets}는 대상 목록, {: Tool description shown to the agent. {targets} is the target list and {count} is the number of targets.
Edit this when the agent is unsure when to hand off work.
text.도구 설명의 {targets}에 들어갈 대상 한 줄입니다. {id}·{r: One target line that goes into {targets} in the tool description. You can use {id}, {role}, {when} and {agent}.
Name of the tool input that receives the target.
Description of the target input field shown to the agent.
Name of the tool input that receives the work to hand off.
Description of the task input field shown to the agent.
text.없는 대상을 불렀을 때 에이전트에게 돌려줄 문구입니다. {target}·: Text returned to the agent when it calls a target that doesn't exist. You can use {target} and {targets}.
Text returned when the call can't be made. You can use {target}.
text.대상 실행이 실패했을 때 돌려줄 문구입니다. {target}·{statu: Text returned when the target's run fails. You can use {target}, {status}, {message} and so on.
Text returned when the target doesn't produce result text.

codes.delegation.backend_unsupported: Backend {backend} doesn't support this delegation strategy.
codes.delegation.duplicate_member: The same delegate is connected twice.
codes.delegation.invalid_config: The independent delegation settings are invalid.
codes.delegation.invalid_result_mode: Unknown result mode on the delegation edge (use text or reply).
